title: A Famous Inventor
text:
Thomas Edison was an American inventor. He was born in Ohio. He is famous for the light bulb. Many people use his ideas every day.

Edison did not stop working after one failure. He tried thousands of materials for the light bulb. His friends called him a hard worker. Today we still use electric lights.

questions.text: What did Edison try many times?
options: To find the right material for the light bulb

questions.text: What can the reader infer about Edison?
options: He was patient and did not give up easily
He stopped working after his first failure
He never talked to his friends

questions.text: Why are Edison's ideas still important today?
options: Because people still use electric lights
Because he wrote many school books
Because he was a famous actor

vocabulary.definition: a person who creates a new machine or product
a result that is not successful

paragraph_translations: Thomas Edison fue un inventor estadounidense. Nació en Ohio. Es famoso por la bombilla. Mucha gente usa sus ideas todos los días.
Edison no dejó de trabajar después de un fracaso. Probó miles de materiales para la bombilla. Sus amigos lo llamaban un trabajador muy dedicado. Hoy todavía usamos luces eléctricas.
